title: Tom Taggart
description: "Next to Aunt Beru, Boba Fett has always been my favorite STAR WARS character," admits Tom Taggart. "He always seems to be in complete control of every situation, never losing his cool. And although he doesn't talk much, most people don't realize he has a lovely singing voice. I was thrilled at the chance to illustrate him." Other Taggart projects include 3D covers for BATMAN, SWAMP THING, DOOM PATROL and ANIMAL MAN (all DC). He's also done work for ELFQUEST, ZEN and SILVER SKULL, but to this day Taggart is best remembered by fans as the original Jan Brady from the popular TV show, THE BRADY BUNCH
